sophia (evals): Heads-up — I'm bringing up v2-rerank-int4 (post-PTQ) on a dedicated pool for a quick smoke. PTQ artifacts passed unit checks but initial eval shows odd embed-scaling effects on long docs.

anya (ml): thanks. what do the numbers look like on a small holdout?

sophia (evals): quick 10k holdout run: NDCG@10 = 0.453 (baseline 0.471, delta -0.018 ~ -3.8%), MRR@10 = 0.312 (baseline 0.310, delta +0.002). Strange mix — overall ndcg down, mrr slightly up.

juan (data): can you slice by query length/cohort? sounds like long-doc tail skew.

sophia (evals): did that — tail cohort (doc_tokens > 300 OR concat_len > 1024) shows NDCG@10 drop of ~6.5% absolute. Core queries (short) are flat or slightly better.

anya (ml): that screams embed rescale mismatch. PTQ sometimes collapses embedding magnitude; if we applied a single global scale after quantization we might have blown distances for long contexts. Did you preserve per-head/step scaling?

sophia (evals): I compared L2 norms for pooled embeddings: baseline median 12.2, v2-int4 median 8.6. So magnitude down ~30%. Ranking distance metric is raw dot-product — that will compress tail gaps.

anya (ml): two quick options: 1) re-run inference with per-example rescale (apply learned multiplier) or 2) switch to cosine-normalized scoring as a stopgap. For repro, try multiplying embeddings by 1.4 and re-eval.

mike (infra): note for the dedicated pool we have kvpack enabled by default; that changes batching behavior slightly. Could that interact?

lee (prod-eng): kvpack affects KV cache layout but shouldn't change final scores — unless tokenization/truncation shifted. Make sure the input sharding is identical between baseline and int4 runs.

ci-bot: CI result: rerank-smoke/v2-int4 finished 2026-02-14T19:03:30Z — ndcg@10=0.453 (-0.018), mrr@10=0.312 (+0.002). Full artifacts: https://ci.internal/reports/3180004444/v2-int4-smoke

sophia (evals): repro commands I ran (copied):
```
./tools/rerank_eval \
  --model v2-rerank-int4 \
  --cohort holdout-10k \
  --scoring dotprod \
  --save-diffs ./out/v2-int4/diffs.jsonl
```
Then a small postproc to rescale embeddings: `python tools/scale_embs.py --in out/v2-int4/embs.npy --factor 1.4 --out out/v2-int4/embs_scaled.npy`

lee (prod-eng): can you share a couple of per-query diffs (ids) where ordering flipped? easiest to triage.

sophia (evals): attaching top 3 flip examples inline (query ids): q_12345, q_99821, q_44012. For q_12345 baseline top3: [docA, docC, docB], v2-int4 top3: [docC, docA, docB] — docC is long (4 paragraphs).

juan (data): adding dataset note: the holdout contains a longform split from longform-qa-2025 that is ~12% of tail queries. Worth isolating.

anya (ml): try this quick probe: run scoring as cosine (normalize both query/doc) and re-eval with identical tokenization. If cosine fixes NDCG for tail, it's probably magnitude issue. If not, maybe quantized attention quirks.

sophia (evals): will run. Command I'm going to use:
```
./tools/rerank_eval --model v2-rerank-int4 --cohort tail-longform --scoring cosine --output tail_cosine.json
```
I'll kick it off now on the canary (dedicated-small).

mike (infra): when you run on canary, set `SERVE_KVPACK=false` in the job env so we rule out KV layout as a confound. I'll stand up a small instance with that override.

ci-bot: Canary job started: canary-3180004444-01 (SERVE_KVPACK=false). Link: https://ci.internal/canaries/3180004444-01

sophia (evals): preliminary cosine run: tail NDCG@10 improved to 0.402 (baseline tail 0.430, v2-int4-dot 0.402 -> same as dot?) Hmm still down. So cosine didn't fully rescue — suggests representation drift beyond scalar scale.

anya (ml): ok next: check per-layer quant scale factors and ensure we didn't clip final projection (pooler) too aggressively. Also check out OTP for attention rounding on long sequences.

lee (prod-eng): small operational ask — keep the canary up and tag as `hold` until we get a green triage. We should avoid rollout until regressions are understood.

juan (data): I'll prepare a smaller reproducible cohort (2k queries) with provenance to share to SRE for deterministic replays.

sophia (evals): action items I have: 1) run per-layer norm dump (any suggestions for quick script?), 2) try re-inflating embeddings by layerwise factors, 3) produce per-query diffs + provenance bundle and share link.

anya (ml): for 1) use `python tools/dump_layer_norms.py --model v2-rerank-int4 --out norms.csv` — you'll see scale per linear/proj layer. For 2) try heuristic: multiply pooler/proj weights by ratio of baseline/pqt medians.

mike (infra): I'll add a small toggle to serving flags so we can fly the same binary with `KVPACK=true/false` easily.

sophia (evals): OK kicking off norms dump now. Will post results and a small CSV. Thanks all — tagging @anya for follow-up on parameter-level rescale idea. :eyes: :mag_right:

anya (ml): got it — I'll try a small PTQ redo with per-channel scale preservation (recompute scales for final proj) and push artifacts later today.

lee (prod-eng): thanks team. keep notes brief in the artifacts so we can link in the canary ticket.

ci-bot: Artifact uploaded: /artifacts/3180004444/norms.csv"
